'''Towen Sor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. A Security Commander in the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]], in [[3630 BBY]] he and a group of [[Skytrooper]]s cornered the rogue terrorist [[Kaliyo Djannis|Firebrand]] in the abandoned tram station in the [[Old World]]. However, during their shoot-out, Firebrand received assistance from [[Theron Shan]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]], who defeated Sor and his skytroopers.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Towen Sor appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter X: Anarchy in Paradise'''.
